pt.r: O Guernsey State Park é um parque estadual em Wyoming, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 15,2 km² e está protegido desde 1934, sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, é uma paisagem protegida, onde natureza e uso humano tradicional convivem.
pt.h: A represa Guernsey, no rio North Platte, foi construída entre 1925 e 1927. Entre 1934 e 1939 a Civilian Conservation Corps ergueu ali construções que estão entre os melhores exemplos de seu trabalho.

en.r: Guernsey State Park is a state park in Wyoming, United States. It covers 15.2 km² and has been protected since 1934. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is a protected landscape, where nature and traditional human use coexist.
en.h: Guernsey Dam on the North Platte was built in 1925–1927. From 1934 to 1939 the Civilian Conservation Corps built structures here that rank among the finest examples of its work.

es.h: La represa Guernsey, en el río North Platte, se construyó entre 1925 y 1927. Entre 1934 y 1939 el Civilian Conservation Corps levantó allí obras que están entre los mejores ejemplos de su trabajo.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional de Grand Teton fica em Wyoming, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 1.255 km² e está protegido desde 1929, sob gestão do Serviço Nacional de Parques dos EUA (NPS). Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: A presença humana tem pelo menos 11.000 anos; os shoshone do leste viviam ali quando chegaram os caçadores de peles, entre 1810 e 1840. O parque foi criado em 1929 só com as montanhas; John D. Rockefeller Jr. comprou terras no vale de Jackson Hole e as doou, e em 1950 elas foram incorporadas.
pt.ff: Protege os grandes picos da cordilheira Teton, de 64 km, e a maior parte do vale Jackson Hole. Com Yellowstone forma o Grande Ecossistema de Yellowstone, um dos maiores ecossistemas temperados intactos do mundo, com bisões, alces, ursos-pardos, lobos e antilocapras.
at: Mormon Row e o celeiro Moulton

en.r: Grand Teton National Park is a national park in Wyoming, United States. It covers 1,255 km² and has been protected since 1929. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Human history here goes back at least 11,000 years; the Eastern Shoshone lived here when fur trappers arrived between 1810 and 1840. The park was created in 1929 with only the mountains; John D. Rockefeller Jr. bought land in Jackson Hole and donated it, and it was added in 1950.
en.ff: It protects the major peaks of the 64 km Teton Range and most of Jackson Hole valley. With Yellowstone it forms the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem, one of the world's largest intact temperate ecosystems, with bison, moose, grizzlies, wolves and pronghorn.
at: Mormon Row and the Moulton barn

es.r: El Grand Teton National Park es un parque nacional en Wyoming, Estados Unidos. Tiene 1.255 km² y está protegido desde 1929, bajo la gestión del Servicio de Parques Nacionales de EE. UU.. En la clasificación de la UICN está en la categoría II, la de los parques nacionales: protege ecosistemas enteros y recibe visitantes.
es.h: La presencia humana tiene al menos 11.000 años; los shoshone del este vivían allí cuando llegaron los tramperos entre 1810 y 1840. El parque se creó en 1929 solo con las montañas; John D. Rockefeller Jr. compró tierras en el valle de Jackson Hole y las donó, y en 1950 se incorporaron.
es.ff: Protege los grandes picos de la cordillera Teton, de 64 km, y la mayor parte del valle Jackson Hole. Con Yellowstone forma el Gran Ecosistema de Yellowstone, uno de los mayores ecosistemas templados intactos del mundo, con bisontes, alces, osos pardos, lobos y berrendos.
at: Mormon Row y el granero Moulton

pt.r: A Fitzpatrick Wilderness é uma área selvagem em Wyoming, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 805 km² e está protegida desde 1976, sob gestão do Serviço Florestal dos EUA. Na classificação da IUCN, é uma área silvestre: um grande espaço pouco alterado, sem infraestrutura permanente.

pt.ff: Na cordilheira Wind River, com algumas das maiores geleiras das Rochosas americanas e o pico Gannett, o mais alto do Wyoming. Ursos estão presentes.

en.r: Fitzpatrick Wilderness is a wilderness area in Wyoming, United States. It covers 805 km² and has been protected since 1976. It is managed by the U.S. Forest Service. Under the IUCN system it is a wilderness area: a large, largely unmodified space without permanent infrastructure.
en.h: Formerly the Glacier Primitive Area, it became a wilderness in 1976; it is named for fur trapper and guide Thomas Fitzpatrick.
en.ff: In the Wind River Range, with some of the largest glaciers in the US Rockies and Gannett Peak, Wyoming's highest. Bears are present.

es.h: Antes llamada Glacier Primitive Area, pasó a área silvestre en 1976; el nombre recuerda al trampero y guía Thomas Fitzpatrick.
es.ff: En la cordillera Wind River, con algunos de los mayores glaciares de las Rocosas de EE. UU. y el pico Gannett, el más alto de Wyoming. Hay osos.

en.r: Seminoe State Park is a state park in Wyoming, United States. It covers 84.4 km² and has been protected since 1965. It is managed by the state government.

Leva o nome do explorador Jim Bridger, um dos primeiros não indígenas a descrever a região. Fica no lado oeste da Divisória Continental, na cordilheira Wind River, e inclui o Gannett Peak, de 4.209 metros, a montanha mais alta do Wyoming. Faz parte do Grande Ecossistema de Yellowstone.

en.r: Bridger Wilderness is a wilderness area in Wyoming, United States. It covers 1,733 km² and has been protected since 1931. It is managed by the U.S. Forest Service. Under the IUCN system it is a wilderness area: a large, largely unmodified space without permanent infrastructure.
en.h: A 428,169-acre (1,732.74 km2) wilderness in Bridger-Teton National Forest, Wyoming, set up as a primitive area in 1931, redesignated wilderness in 1964 and enlarged in 1984. It is named for explorer Jim Bridger, one of the first non-Native people to describe the area. It lies on the west side of the Continental Divide in the Wind River Range and contains 13,809-foot (4,209 m) Gannett Peak, Wyoming's highest mountain. It is part of the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem.
en.ff: The extract does not describe wildlife or plants; the highlight is the high mountains.

en.ff: The Middle Fork of the Popo Agie River vanishes into a limestone cavern, 'the Sinks', and re-emerges a quarter-mile down the canyon in a pool, 'the Rise'.

en.r: Forte Bridger is a protected area in Wyoming, United States. It covers 16 hectares and has been protected since 1928. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is a natural monument: it protects a specific feature such as a waterfall, a cave or a rock formation.
en.h: A historic site in Uinta County, Wyoming, on Blacks Fork, where mountain man Jim Bridger and Louis Vasquez set up a fur trading post in 1842, then in Mexican territory. It became a vital resupply stop on the Oregon, California and Mormon trails; it was an Army post from 1858 to 1890.

O Rio North Platte a atravessa; em Wyoming é considerado pesqueiro de primeira em todo o trecho, e no Colorado é "Gold Medal water".

en.r: Platte River Wilderness is a wilderness area in Wyoming, United States. It covers 91.2 km² and has been protected since 1984. It is managed by the U.S. Forest Service. Under the IUCN system it is a wilderness area: a large, largely unmodified space without permanent infrastructure.
en.h: A 95 km² wilderness in Medicine Bow-Routt National Forest, split between southern Wyoming and northern Colorado, designated in 1984 by the Wyoming Wilderness Act. The North Platte River runs through it; in Wyoming it is a blue-ribbon fishery for its whole length, and in Colorado a Gold Medal water.
en.ff: The conifer forests were almost entirely burned in the 2020 Mullen Fire, but the mosaic of burned and unburned areas improved habitat for elk, mule deer and bighorn sheep.
at: Blue-ribbon fishing on the North Platte
A landscape recovering from the 2020 fire

es.h: Sitio histórico en el condado de Carbon, Wyoming, donde la Union Pacific cruzaba el río North Platte: el fuerte Fred Steele, levantado en 1868 para proteger la construcción del ferrocarril transcontinental. Recién fundado recibió a los generales Ulysses S. Grant y William T. Sherman.

en.r: Granger Stage Station State Historic Site is a state historic site in Wyoming, United States. It has been protected since 1856 and is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is a natural monument: it protects a specific feature such as a waterfall, a cave or a rock formation.
en.h: A historic site in Granger, Wyoming, where Hams Fork meets Blacks Fork of the Green River, site of a ferry from about 1856. It was a Pony Express station in 1860-1861 and an Overland Trail station in 1862, until the Union Pacific arrived in 1868.

pt.r: O Point of Rocks Stage Station State Historic Site é um sítio histórico estadual em Wyoming, nos Estados Unidos. Está sob gestão do governo estadual. Na classificação da IUCN, é um monumento natural: protege uma feição específica, como uma cachoeira, uma caverna ou uma formação rochosa.
pt.h: Antiga parada de diligências no condado de Sweetwater, Wyoming, no encontro da Overland Trail com a Union Pacific, erguida em 1861 ou 1862. Serviu à linha de diligências até 1868, quando chegou o trem; depois foi depósito de carga e residência. É do estado desde 1947.

en.r: Point of Rocks Stage Station State Historic Site is a state historic site in Wyoming, United States. It is managed by the state government. Under the IUCN system it is a natural monument: it protects a specific feature such as a waterfall, a cave or a rock formation.
en.h: A former stagecoach stop in Sweetwater County, Wyoming, where the Overland Trail met the Union Pacific, built in 1861 or 1862. It served the stage line until 1868, when the railroad arrived; later it was a freight depot and a home. State-owned since 1947.

es.h: Antigua parada de diligencias en el condado de Sweetwater, Wyoming, donde la Overland Trail se cruzaba con la Union Pacific, construida en 1861 o 1862. Sirvió a la línea de diligencias hasta 1868, cuando llegó el tren; después fue depósito de carga y vivienda. Es del estado desde 1947.

pt.r: O Wyoming Territorial Prison State Historic Site é um sítio histórico estadual em Wyoming, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 84 hectares e está protegido desde 2004, sob gestão do governo estadual.
pt.h: Antiga prisão perto de Laramie, Wyoming, construída em 1872, um dos prédios mais antigos do estado. Foi penitenciária federal até 1890 e estadual até 1901, depois estação experimental da Universidade de Wyoming até 1989; abriu ao público em 1991 e virou sítio histórico em 2004.

en.r: Wyoming Territorial Prison State Historic Site is a state historic site in Wyoming, United States. It covers 84 hectares and has been protected since 2004. It is managed by the state government.
en.h: A former prison near Laramie, Wyoming, built in 1872, one of the state's oldest buildings. It was a federal penitentiary until 1890 and a state prison until 1901, then a University of Wyoming experiment station until 1989; it opened to the public in 1991 and became a historic site in 2004.

es.r: El Wyoming Territorial Prison State Historic Site es un sitio histórico estatal en Wyoming, Estados Unidos. Tiene 84 hectáreas y está protegido desde 2004, bajo la gestión del gobierno estatal.
es.h: Antigua cárcel cerca de Laramie, Wyoming, construida en 1872, uno de los edificios más antiguos del estado. Fue penitenciaría federal hasta 1890 y estatal hasta 1901, luego estación experimental de la Universidad de Wyoming hasta 1989; abrió al público en 1991 y es sitio histórico desde 2004.

en.r: Boysen State Park is a state park in Wyoming, United States. It covers 145 km² and has been protected since 1956.
en.h: Established in 1956 after Boysen Dam was completed in 1951. It is named for Asmus Boysen, who built the site's first dam in 1908; part of it can still be seen.
en.ff: The reservoir holds walleye, sauger, perch and rainbow, cutthroat and brown trout.

pt.r: A Fort Supply é uma área protegida em Wyoming, nos Estados Unidos. Está protegida desde 1853, sob gestão do governo estadual.
pt.h: Forte de pioneiros mórmons no vale Bridger, fundado em 1853 e abandonado na Guerra de Utah de 1857. Servia de base missionária e abastecia os pioneiros a caminho de Salt Lake City. O local fica perto de Robertson, Wyoming, e um monumento é mantido como anexo do Fort Bridger State Historic Site.

en.r: Fort Supply is a protected area in Wyoming, United States. It has been protected since 1853 and is managed by the state government.
en.h: A Mormon pioneer fort in the Bridger Valley, founded in 1853 and abandoned during the Utah War of 1857. It served as a missionary base and supplied pioneers heading to Salt Lake City. The site is near Robertson, Wyoming, and a monument is kept as a satellite of Fort Bridger State Historic Site.

es.r: La Fort Supply es un área protegida en Wyoming, Estados Unidos. Está protegida desde 1853, bajo la gestión del gobierno estatal.
es.h: Fuerte de pioneros mormones en el valle Bridger, fundado en 1853 y abandonado en la Guerra de Utah de 1857. Servía de base misionera y abastecía a los pioneros rumbo a Salt Lake City. El lugar está cerca de Robertson, Wyoming, y un monumento se mantiene como anexo del Fort Bridger State Historic Site.
